claims.statement: Understanding-only pages are registered as `reference`: they reach `readPlan` never, produce no `[READ FIRST]` block and carry no signature obligation — registering them only keeps the machine-checked links resolvable.
Moving an id from `reference` into `scene` or `reqStage` is the single-point way to make a page gated; the generator and the gate follow automatically, so no second edit is needed anywhere.
